t: The Hills: Out With The Old
d: After a rocky summer with her boyfriend Jason, Lauren decides to break it off and returns to work to face her boss. Heidi finds herself in trouble with a guy both she and Audrina are dating. (S2, ep1)

t: The Hills: When You Least Expect It / The Best Night Ever
st: When You Least Expect It / The Best Night Ever
d: Lauren goes on her first date since Jason and is tested at work when she's asked to work a fashion show. Heidi has a life changing secret she must tell her boyfriend. (S2, ep2)

t: The Hills: Who Do You Trust? / One Big Interruption
st: Who Do You Trust? / One Big Interruption
d: Audrina tells Heidi about Spencer's cheating ways, but Heidi is doubtful - until she sees it for herself. Lauren continues to wonder whether she is ready for a relationship. (S2, ep4)

t: The Hills: You Have Chosen / With Friends Like These...
st: You Have Chosen / With Friends Like These...
d: Heidi and Lauren get into a major argument about Spencer as Lauren feels like she is losing Heidi as a friend. (S2, ep6)

t: The Hills: Enough Is Enough / New Year, New Friends
st: Enough Is Enough / New Year, New Friends
d: Spencer asks Heidi to move in with him but Heidi doesn't know what to do or how to tell her roommate, Lauren. (S2, ep8)

After making her hip-hop debut alongside French Montana two years ago, Drita jumps at the opportunity to write another track inspired by her life, but finds herself at a loss for words when it's time to put the pen-to-the-pad.
Natalie is having a blowout Halloween party at her funeral home and everyone is invited, including Renee, though Renee's not so sure the invite is sincere.
A visit to the morgue launches 16 of the best tattoo artists into a brutal competition to determine who's number 1 and "tattoo virgins" get their first taste of ink. (S2, ep1)
Semi nude women heat up the competition, a medical emergency threatens the future of one artist, and NFL Linebacker Terrell Suggs is a guest judge. (S2, ep2)
Vin is hired by a voyeuristic couple to perform with two female escorts.

Steven contemplates a long term job that would take him on a European tour.
Brace considers undergoing a vasectomy.

Paris and Nicole stop at a ranch in Texas, where they give the father tips on being romantic with his wife; the pair get jobs at the local sheriff's station but their wild antics do not impress the boss.
Paris and Nicole must take care of a toddler, as well as throw a party for his second birthday.
Paris and Nicole spend the day tending to the needs and whims of four rambunctious kids.
The girls intern at a manufacturing firm where their work proves dull, however they manage to have fun with their host family.
Paris and Nicole trade in their designer dresses for traditional Pakistani attire when they take over the responsibilities of a Pakistani housewife.
After once again giving up their lives of luxury, Paris and Nicole take a bus to stay with their first host family and prepare for their first internship as car mechanics.
Paris can’t stand to spend another day as a housewife and hires an impersonator to take her place, giving Nicole an opportunity to exact her revenge.
Havoc ensues when Paris and Nicole begin an internship with the Atlantic City Fire Department, while they task themselves with finding the daughter of their host family a new friend.
A stop in Texas brings Paris and Nicole to their new host family; the women convince the Lutz-Carillos boys to sneak out with them to go tanning.
Paris and Nicole arrive in Pennsylvania, where they stay with a family whose cat injures Nicole's dog, while their internship involves working at an airport.

Paris and Nicole finally get a job they enjoy: working at a gas station, where there are plenty of guys to flirt with; but a confrontation erupts when Albert and Janet tell the girls to stay away from the small town boys, and the girls disobey them.
Paris and Nicole reminisce about their month in Altus, make amends, and say goodbye to the people they’ve come to know before returning to Los Angeles.
